meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地 AI 模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用本地模型。
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to call local models from a container via OpenAI-compatible API.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会多出两个工具：一个列出 Atomic Chat 本地应用里可用的模型，另一个把提示词发给指定模型并取回回答。Claude 仍是主控，可以把部分任务转交给本地模型。
howto.when: 当你想让容器里的 Claude 调用本机 Atomic Chat 的本地模型，或要求配置这个 MCP 服务时，会执行本技能完成安装、注册和验证。

say.text: 用 Atomic Chat 告诉我法国的首都
say.note: Claude 会先列出模型，再生成回答。

say.text: 先列出 Atomic Chat 现在有哪些模型
用 Atomic Chat 里的模型解释一下冒泡排序
say.note: 会调用 atomic_chat_generate 生成回答。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can use two extra tools: one lists models available in the local Atomic Chat desktop app, and the other sends a prompt to a chosen model and returns the reply. Claude stays the orchestrator and can hand some work to local models.
howto.when_en: This skill runs when you want Claude in the container to call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app, or when you ask it to configure this MCP server. It installs, registers, and verifies the integration.

say_en.text: Use Atomic Chat to tell me the capital of France.
say_en.note: Claude lists models first, then generates a reply.

say_en.text: List the models available in Atomic Chat right now.
Use a model in Atomic Chat to explain bubble sort.
say_en.note: Calls atomic_chat_generate to produce the answer.
